purpose: Presentation-only explanations of existing source-backed ownership links. Stable graph IDs, edges and money records remain unchanged.

verification.method: Read original OGE disclosure text and ownership rows; checked against existing canonical edges. Percentages are holdings as disclosed, not inferred personal cash, voting power or complete legal agreements.
verification.family_group_basis: The original filing uses Trump Family Members at rows 114 and 124 without naming the members or allocating their collective share.

facts.text: This label groups relatives listed collectively as Trump Family Members in the disclosure. Together, they hold 30% of DT Marks Defi LLC and 30% of DT Marks SC LLC.

The filing does not identify those relatives, divide the 30% among them or state their personal cash distributions. The percentage applies to each DT Marks company, not directly to World Liberty Financial.
This company holds a disclosed 38.25% stake in Stablecoin Holdco LLC. Its filing also records proceeds from new capital and a sale of interests in that holding company.
The three owners below together account for this company’s ownership. The 30% family entry is collective; the filing does not name those relatives or show their individual payouts.

facts.text: This is the company that holds the 1% stake in DT Marks SC LLC. DTTM Operations Managing Member Corp owns all of this member corporation.

It is a separate ownership link from DTTM Operations LLC’s 69% stake. The disclosure does not explain this corporation’s operating duties or voting powers, or show a personal payout from its 1% stake.
This company holds the 1% stake in DT Marks Defi LLC. DTTM Operations Managing Member Corp owns all of this member corporation.

The filing identifies it as the former DT Tower II Member Corp. Its 1% is separate from DTTM Operations LLC’s 69%; the disclosure does not establish its voting powers or an individual’s cash receipts.
DTTM Operations LLC owns 69% of DT Marks Defi LLC and 69% of DT Marks SC LLC. It also lists interests in other companies, trademarks, copyrights and World Liberty governance tokens.

DJT Holdings LLC owns 99% of DTTM Operations; DTTM Operations Managing Member Corp owns the other 1%. These are ownership links. They do not show that company receipts were paid through to Donald Trump personally.
This corporation owns the DT Marks SC and Defi member corporations, which each hold a 1% stake in the corresponding DT Marks LLC. It separately owns 1% of DTTM Operations LLC.

DJT Holdings Managing Member LLC owns all of this corporation. The disclosure documents those stakes; it does not describe this corporation’s day-to-day duties or detailed voting and distribution rights.
Donald Trump identifies himself as this trust’s sole beneficiary. The filing lists the trust as owner of CIC Digital and of interests in the DJT Holdings companies above DTTM in the ownership chain.
facts.locator: Part 3 · PDF page 4; Schedule 1 rows 21 and 31–32 · PDF pages 848 and 850

facts.text: The trust directly owns 99% of DJT Holdings LLC and all of DJT Holdings Managing Member LLC, which owns the remaining 1%. Being the beneficiary connects Trump to these assets, but does not establish a personal cash payout from every company below them.
